sterlet.name: Sterlet caviar
sterlet.description: Delicate caviar with a tender texture. Grain size: 1.5–2 mm. Colour: dark grey to deep black.
sterlet.taste: Mild and delicate, with a light saltiness. The small grains pop gently and melt in the mouth. A good choice if you’re trying black caviar for the first time.
sterlet.grain: 1.5–2 mm; from grey to deep black.
sterlet.ingredients: Granular sturgeon caviar, food-grade salt, preservative E200.
sterlet.storage: Unopened: Store at −4 °C to −2 °C for up to 12 months. After opening: Keep at 0 °C to +6 °C and consume within 48 hours.
sterlet.nutrition: 240 kcal; protein — 21.2 g; fat — 18 g (saturated — 3 g); carbohydrates — 0 g.
sterlet.pairing: with blini or toast with butter. Pair with brut Champagne, dry white wine or chilled vodka.
sterlet.servingAlt: Sterlet caviar on four mother-of-pearl spoons
sterlet.detailServingAlt: Sterlet caviar on mother-of-pearl spoons among white stones

hybrid.name: Beluga hybrid caviar
hybrid.description: A distinctive taste with a nutty finish. Grain size: 2–2.5 mm. Colour: light grey to brown.
hybrid.taste: Distinctive, with a clean, nutty finish. The delicate grains have soft shells and pop gently in the mouth.
hybrid.fish: Bester - Beluga Hybrid (Huso huso × Acipenser ruthenus).
hybrid.grain: 2–2.5 mm; from light grey to brown.
hybrid.ingredients: Granular sturgeon caviar, food-grade salt, preservative E200.
hybrid.storage: Unopened: Store at −4 °C to −2 °C for up to 12 months. After opening: Keep at 0 °C to +6 °C and consume within 48 hours.
hybrid.nutrition: 210 kcal; protein — 22.2 g; fat — 14.2 g (saturated — 2.5 g); carbohydrates — 0 g.
hybrid.pairing: with avocado, a quail egg or pancakes with cream cheese. Pair with brut Champagne or chilled vodka.
hybrid.servingAlt: Beluga hybrid caviar in a glass bowl on ice
hybrid.detailServingAlt: Beluga hybrid caviar with salmon and avocado

premium.name: Premium sturgeon caviar
premium.description: Select caviar for special moments, from sturgeon aged 10 years and older. Grain size: 3–3.5 mm.
premium.intro: Premium is carefully selected caviar for special moments, harvested from sturgeon aged 10 years or more. This category features large grains measuring 3–3.5 mm. The flavour profile varies depending on the fish species.
premium.taste: Rich, with nutty and creamy notes and a long finish. The large grains have a buttery texture and pop gently in the mouth, leaving a pleasant saltiness.
premium.fish: Siberian Sturgeon (Acipenser baerii); Russian Sturgeon (Acipenser gueldenstaedtii); Beluga Hybrid (Huso huso × Acipenser ruthenus).
premium.grain: 3–3.5 mm; from fish aged 10 years and older.
premium.ingredients: Granular sturgeon caviar, food-grade salt, preservative E200.
premium.storage: Unopened: Store at −4 °C to −2 °C for up to 12 months. After opening: Keep at 0 °C to +6 °C and consume within 48 hours.
premium.nutrition: 210 kcal; protein — 22.2 g; fat — 14.2 g (saturated — 2.5 g); carbohydrates — 0 g.
premium.pairing: on its own from a mother-of-pearl spoon, or with a fresh oyster or warm baked potato. Pair with brut Champagne, alcohol-free sparkling wine or chilled vodka.
premium.latinNote: The Premium category may include Siberian Sturgeon, Russian Sturgeon or Beluga Hybrid caviar. The flavour profile varies by species.
premium.servingAlt: Premium caviar in glass bowls on ice
premium.detailServingAlt: Salmon bites topped with Premium caviar

trout.name: Trout caviar
trout.description: Red caviar with a delicate, lightly salted taste, from trout raised in spring water. Grain size: 3–4 mm.
trout.taste: Bright and fresh, with a light saltiness and subtle sweetness. The firm grains pop in the mouth, releasing their flavour.
trout.ingredients: Trout roe, food-grade salt, preservatives E211 and E200.
trout.storage: Unopened: Store at −2 °C to +2 °C for up to 45 days. After opening: Keep at 0 °C to +4 °C and consume within 48 hours.
trout.nutrition: 233.7 kcal; protein — 28.6 g; fat — 3.4 g (saturated — 2.18 g); carbohydrates — 0 g.
trout.pairing: with toast and butter, blini or a boiled egg. Pair with dry white wine or brut sparkling wine.
